stops.note: com- 'with' plus a root related to hortus 'garden' - originally an enclosure, later a body of troops
stops.meaning: an enclosure; a retinue of troops

stops.note: named the attendants who followed a person of rank
from Italian 'corte', court, the royal retinue
adopted for a solemn ceremonial procession

current_meaning: a solemn procession, especially for a funeral
